# Geode Roll

> Geode Roll is a puzzle game for iPhone (iOS 15 or later). Each island is a small stone cube floating in a midday sky; steer a hollow across its six faces, swallow what fits to grow, and gather the goal before the sun sets. Coming soon to the App Store.

- Controls: drag anywhere to steer the hollow. It swallows anything smaller than itself and widens through eight sizes as it eats. Slide over an edge and the whole cube rolls a quarter turn, bringing the next face toward you. Ridges and ponds block the way.
- The far side stays out of sight; a six-face map counts what each face still holds.
- Each island has its own sun and 40 to 160 seconds of daylight. Gather the goal (often a geode heart) before Nightfall: finish with 40% of the daylight left for three facets, 20% for two. No lives and no energy to wait for.
- 75 islands in five ranges: Quartz Shelf (islands 1 to 15, free), then Amethyst Hollow, Citrine Mesa, Opal Drift and Obsidian Crown (15 each, opened together by the Full Atlas).
- Boosters: Glint (shows where the things you still need are), Linger (more daylight), Gulp (the hollow grows one size at once). The first clear of every fifth island gives one.
- Purchases (optional): Full Atlas ($3.99, one-time, opens the other 60 islands); Prospector's Satchel ($0.99, two Glint, two Linger and two Gulp). Restore purchases is in Settings and in the Shop.
- No ads, no account, no analytics or tracking. Progress stays on the device and the game plays offline; only purchases talk to the App Store. English only.
